summary: Third testing_agent run for SmartScape covering the new features: Push-to-Autodesk, live zone editing (LandUseBar), zoning reset, scope warning, and BUG verification for 'autodesk is showing error'. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 14 new tests (TestZoning x10, TestAutodeskPush x3, TestScopeWarning x1) — total 49/49 pass. Frontend flows validated end-to-end (demo login -> integrations page callback pre-flight card -> project autodesk not-connected card with copy-callback-btn + goto-integrations + NO push-btn -> zoning map edit -> drag land-use-handle-4 and land-use-handle-1 keeping alloc-total at 100% -> live-score delta +3.7 -> apply persists across reload -> reset restores recommended -> blueprint page). Zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG VERIFIED: /projects/{id}/autodesk renders the amber 'not connected' card, exposes data-testid='callback-url' identical to /api/autodesk/status.callback_url, plus copy-callback-btn and goto-integrations. No crash, no red error screen, no infinite spinner. The autodesk-push-btn is correctly gated behind `linked` and never appears in the not-connected state. Same callback pre-flight card is present on /integrations. All Autodesk-dependent APIs degrade gracefully (409 not-connected, 404 no-link, 400 nothing-to-push, 502 for upstream/fake-token failures) — never 500.
server.py is ~1030 lines including geometry/APS/planning/auth — still recommend modularization for maintainability (auth.py, autodesk.py, planning.py, geometry.py, projects.py, zoning.py).

ZoningIn validation is solid: missing/extra keys => 400, negatives => 400, sum-off-100 => 400 with a helpful 'Allocations must total 100%' message, unknown project => 404, unauthenticated => 401 — all verified.
compute_sustainability now correctly accepts green_ratio and returns green_space_pct == parks_green (verified with parks_green=23 -> 23.0).
recompute_zoning correctly re-clips polygons inside an uploaded boundary and preserves site_area (zone-area sum within 5% of site_area).
reset_zoning fully clears land_use_custom via $unset and rebuilds zones from URDPFI defaults — verified with regression assertion (all 7 keys match RECOMMENDED within 0.5%).
push_to_autodesk: 404 when no link, 400 when nothing-to-push, non-500 (502) with readable detail when APS returns 401 via bogus token, project document not corrupted — verified.
APS_SCOPES now includes data:create; /autodesk/status returns scope, so the frontend Integrations page can render data-testid='scope-warning' when a stale token lacks it (backend surface verified).
MINOR UX: resetAlloc() does NOT auto-exit edit mode, so users see Apply/Reset/Cancel after a reset. Intentional? — consider setEditing(false) so the button reverts to 'Edit land use'. Non-blocking.
test_credentials: Demo login POST /api/auth/demo (demo@smartscape.ai / smartscape-demo). Fake APS token injected into db.aps_tokens for push + scope-warning tests, cleaned up in finally.
seed_data_creation: TestZoning uses module-scoped TEST_zoning_project (created via API, deleted in teardown). TestAutodeskPush reuses zoning_project + injects a bogus APS token doc (removed after each test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now covers 49 tests: auth (JWT + session + Google), Autodesk OAuth (status/connect-url/callback/hubs/hub-projects/link/unlink/contents), projects CRUD, chat, search, boundary (PUT/DELETE with FeatureCollection/Polygon/MultiPolygon/invalid/404/401), Autodesk-link (409/404/idempotent/fake-token-graceful), Zoning (preview/persist/validation/boundary-clip/reset), Autodesk-push (no-link 404/fake-token-502/nothing-to-push 400), and scope-warning (data:create missing). Real Autodesk OAuth cannot be automated — tests use temporary db.aps_tokens injection. Frontend data-testids present and verified: project-autodesk-page, callback-url, copy-callback-btn, goto-integrations, autodesk-push-btn (hidden when not linked), scope-warning, edit-landuse-btn, apply-landuse-btn, reset-landuse-btn, cancel-landuse-btn, alloc-total, live-score, land-use-handle-{0..5}, land-use-seg-{type}, blueprint-download-pdf.
rca of the issue: User-reported 'autodesk is showing error in Autodesk sync' is a config issue on Autodesk's side: the callback URL https://smartcity-planning.preview.emergentagent.com/api/autodesk/callback is not registered in the user's APS app, so Autodesk's sign-in page returns a 'request error'. Our app now surfaces this clearly via prominent copy-callback-URL pre-flight cards on both /integrations and /projects/{id}/autodesk (data-testid='callback-url' + copy-callback-btn). Every Autodesk-dependent endpoint degrades gracefully (409/404/400/502, never 500) as verified by TestAutodesk*/TestAutodeskLink/TestAutodeskPush suites. No code fix required beyond the UX surfacing already applied.
